elements.description:
The person's long-running jobs: a header indicator with overall progress, and a panel of running, queued, done
and failed tasks with Cancel, Retry and Open.

properties.name: tasks
properties.description: The tasks, in any order – the panel groups them by status and keeps their order within a group

properties.name: layout
properties.description: "indicator" (default): the header button that opens the panel; "panel": the panel inline, as a card

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the indicator's panel is open

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The panel's title, and the start of the indicator's name

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Shown in the panel when there are no tasks

properties.name: announce
properties.description: What's announced when a task finishes or fails; default “<label> ready” and “<label> failed”

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-task-cancel
events.description: Cancel was chosen; detail `{ task, tasks }` (`tasks` without it). Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app cancels it

events.name: tc-task-retry
events.description: Retry was chosen on a failed task; detail `{ task, tasks }` (`tasks` with it queued again). Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app retries it

events.name: tc-task-open
events.description: Open was chosen on a done task; detail `{ task, tasks }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops a `result.href` link being followed

events.name: tc-clear-finished
events.description: Clear finished was chosen; detail `{ cleared, tasks }` (`tasks` without the done and failed ones). Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app clears them

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The panel is opening or closing; detail `{ open }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps it as it is

functions.name: taskTime
functions.description: A time as the app reported it: 45s · 2m 05s · 1h 05m

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's title, and the start of the indicator's name – "Background tasks" by default

props.name: tasks
props.description: The tasks. Controlled when defined: Cancel, Retry and Clear finished only report, and you update the list

props.name: defaultTasks
props.description: The tasks when uncontrolled – the component applies Cancel, Retry and Clear finished itself

props.name: onTasksChange
props.description: Called with the list as it is after Cancel, Retry or Clear finished, and what happened

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel was chosen on a running or queued task

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was chosen on a failed task

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Open was chosen on a done task; return false to stop a `result.href` link being followed

props.name: onClearFinished
props.description: Clear finished was chosen, with the done and failed tasks it removes

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the indicator's panel is open. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the panel starts open when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The panel opened or closed

changelog: **Feedback and onboarding:** - `tc-stories`: a gradient ring for new updates that opens a modal viewer; - `tc-background-tasks`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
